notes: Official QSC spec sheet ("SPA Series Spec Sheet 09/17/2020", covers SPA2-60/SPA4-60/SPA2-200/SPA4-100) confirms: 2-channel Class-D amp, 60W/ch into 4 or 8 ohm, bridgeable to 200W (250W peak) into 70V/100V. No network (Ethernet/RJ45) or RS-232 port on this model — this is the standalone (non-networked) SPA series, distinct from QSC's networked SPA-Q series (SPAQ-100-2F/SPAQ-200-4F) which does have Q-SYS network connectivity. Input/output connectors are shared multi-position Euroblock terminal blocks (5-position input, 4-position output) rather than per-channel discrete jacks, so both audio channels physically land on the same strip; could not confirm from the spec sheet whether QSC's silkscreen splits these into separately labeled "1"/"2" sub-sections. AC inlet type is inferred as IEC (C13/C14) from "IEC Cable" being listed in carton contents; the spec sheet does not show a rear-panel photo or explicit IEC sub-type. No grade-eligible connectors are present (no HDMI/SDI/DisplayPort/USB/Ethernet), so no grade fields were set. Cross-checked against QSC's Q-SYS product listing (qsys.com) for the same model, which corroborates no Ethernet/RS-232 port and lists the same electrical specs.

ports.name: Input 1/2 (Audio In)
ports.note: 3.5 mm Euroblock terminal block, 5-position (green); balanced/unbalanced line input for both channels, shared terminal block

ports.name: Remote
ports.note: 3.5 mm Euroblock, 5-position (black); general-purpose inputs for remote volume and remote standby (10k potentiometer not included)

ports.name: Output 1/2 (Speaker Out)
ports.note: 5 mm Euroblock terminal block, 4-position (green); speaker-level output for both channels, Low-Z (4/8 ohm) or 70V/100V, shared terminal block

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: Universal Power Supply 100-240 VAC 50-60 Hz; carton includes IEC power cable, consistent with an IEC C13/C14-style inlet; exact IEC sub-type not explicitly stated on spec sheet
